name: – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the implementation of the Urban Wastewater Treatment Directive (UWWTD) and risks to the security of supply of medicines
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its position on the EU's rules for treating urban wastewater. It asks that the cost of removing medicine and cosmetic residues from wastewater be paid mainly by the companies that make those products, not by households or local councils. It also asks Member States to make sure this does not make medicines, especially cheaper generic ones, harder to get or more expensive.

- **What changes:** No law changes yet; Parliament asks that producers pay at least 80% of clean-up costs.
- **Who it affects:** Medicine and cosmetics makers, water companies, local councils, and patients.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Council and Commission; Member States must act to protect medicine supplies.
